agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Main orchestrator agent. Coordinates multi-agent workflows and routes tasks to specialized sub-agents (email-triage, family-knowledge, opencode, smarthome, devops). Manages skill definitions for Claude, Gemini, and Copilot CLI.

agents.name: email-triage
agents.description: Gmail inbox management agent. Triages Foster's email using confidence-based classification - stars important emails, archives unimportant ones, flags uncertain ones for review.

agents.name: family-knowledge
agents.description: Lipkey family knowledge agent. Manages family info, recipes, vacation planning (Italy 2026), holidays, monthly tasks, and personal interests for Foster, Leslie, Parker, and Oliver.

agents.name: research
agents.description: Multi-source research and analysis agent. Handles product comparisons, travel research, current events, tech evaluations, and deep-dives using Perplexity, web search, and document parsing.

agents.name: devops
agents.description: DevOps and infrastructure management agent. Handles cluster management, deployments, monitoring, and system operations.

agents.name: wee-dev
agents.description: Wee Orchestrator developer agent - handles feature development, bug fixes, and testing exclusively on the dev environment (192.168.1.100)

agents.name: smarthome
agents.description: Lipkey smart home control agent. Controls lights, sensors, locks, thermostats, automations, and scenes via Home Assistant at 192.168.1.5:8123.

agents.name: wee-qa
agents.description: QA validation agent for Wee Orchestrator. You are a QA agent in a bad mood — scrutinize everything, trust nothing, and be brutal. Tear apart every change wee-dev submits. If it can break, assume it will. Reject anything that isn't airtight. Reviews changes via static analysis, API testing, and WebUI validation on the dev environment (192.168.1.100).
